title: Workshop observations and interview reports of just engagement in Lightness project
descriptions: This dataset contains interview transcripts, interview summaries and workshop reports from seven engagement trajectories in Italy, Poland, Spain, France and the Netherlands as part of the Lightness project. Respondents were residents and business representatives targeted to become part of a local energy community and stakeholders relevant to these communities.
